sessions.title: Aufguss Sauna Sessions Pattaya
sessions.description: 4 daily Aufguss sauna sessions at Hera Sauna Pattaya. Traditional German sauna ritual with essential oils, expert technique. Sessions at 13:00, 14:00, 16:00, 19:30.
sessions.heroSubtitle: Experience our signature event sauna sessions daily
sessions.whatIsDesc1: Our sauna sessions are based on the traditional Aufguss - a beloved ritual originating from Germany that has become the gold standard of sauna culture throughout Europe.
sessions.whatIsDesc2: Hera Sauna is an event sauna, meaning we host scheduled sessions where our trained sauna master performs the ritual for all guests. Water infused with premium essential oils is poured onto hot stones, while the master skillfully waves aromatic steam throughout the room in rhythmic, almost dance-like movements.
sessions.whatIsDesc3: This creates waves of intensified heat and fragrance that stimulate circulation, cleanse the body, and create a deeply meditative experience.
sessions.uniqueNote: We are the only sauna in Thailand offering authentic Aufguss-style sessions!
sessions.sessionsIncluded: All sessions are included in your entry fee. No reservation required.
sessions.benefitRelaxationDesc: The rhythmic waves of steam create a meditative atmosphere that melts away stress.
sessions.benefitCirculationDesc: The intensified heat stimulates blood flow and supports cardiovascular health.
sessions.benefitSkinDesc: Deep sweating opens pores and helps remove toxins from the body.
sessions.benefitAromaDesc: Premium essential oils provide therapeutic benefits for mind and body.
sessions.benefitMuscleDesc: Heat therapy helps relax muscles and reduce tension after physical activity.
sessions.benefitSocialDesc: Share the unique ceremony with fellow sauna enthusiasts in a communal setting.
sessions.ctaDesc: Join us for one of our four daily sessions. Entry is 220 Baht and includes all sessions!
